test_inputs.explanation: The execution trace only shows repeated navigation to the Magento admin customer grid URLs (/admin/customer/ and /admin/customer/index/) with all actions marked as unknown, so it does not explicitly reveal credentials or which mass action was chosen. To provide realistic, working test inputs that fit the given schema, standard Magento-style defaults are used: username 'admin' and password 'admin123' (common in local/docker demo setups). Since the agent is clearly working on the customer grid but no specific row IDs or group labels are visible, a generic and valid mass action 'delete' is chosen with 'select_visible' as the selection mode, which requires no specific IDs. 'customer_ids' and 'target_group' are set to null because they are not applicable for this configuration. 'wait_for_success' is set to true to exercise the success-message handling logic. These inputs conform to the schema and are suitable for replaying a realistic test of the tool, but they are inferred defaults rather than values directly observed in the trace.
